sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: When reporter Julie Blusset got on a plane to Hong Kong in November of last year,
sentences.zh: 去年11月，记者朱莉·布鲁塞特登上了飞往香港的飞机，

sentences.en: she thought she was going to cover the aftermath of a disaster.
sentences.zh: 她以为自己要去报道一场灾难的后续。

sentences.en: Julie is a China correspondent for the Dutch newspaper De Volkskrant.
sentences.zh: 朱莉是荷兰《人民报》的驻华记者。

sentences.en: I'd seen the images on the news the evening before.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，我在新闻里看到了那些画面。

sentences.en: Seven huge residential towers in the Tai Po neighborhood of Hong Kong,
sentences.zh: 香港大埔区七栋巨大的住宅楼，

sentences.en: completely engulfed in flames.
sentences.zh: 完全被火焰吞没。

sentences.en: By the time I landed, 20 hours had passed.
sentences.zh: 我落地时，已经过去了20个小时。

sentences.en: I figured the fire would be out, and I'd be documenting the wreckage, talking to survivors.
sentences.zh: 我以为火应该已经灭了，我能去记录残骸，采访幸存者。

sentences.en: But that's not what she found.
sentences.zh: 但她看到的并非如此。

sentences.en: When I got there, the buildings, all part of this complex called Wang Fuk Court,
sentences.zh: 当我到达那里时，这些建筑——它们都属于一个叫宏福苑的住宅区——

sentences.en: were still burning.
sentences.zh: 依然在燃烧。

sentences.en: Not smoldering, but burning.
sentences.zh: 不是冒烟，而是在燃烧。

sentences.en: Seven towers, 32 stories each, and still on fire.
sentences.zh: 七栋楼，每栋32层，依然在起火。

sentences.en: Still billowing smoke.
sentences.zh: 依然浓烟滚滚。

sentences.en: There's, I guess there's one or two towers that are completely blackened,
sentences.zh: 我想，大概有一两栋楼已经完全烧黑了，

sentences.en: and then there's a few that are just filled with smoke.
sentences.zh: 还有几栋楼里全是烟。

sentences.en: It's kind of insane.
sentences.zh: 简直不可思议。

sentences.en: And every so often, you'd hear it before you saw it.
sentences.zh: 而且每隔一会儿，你还没看到火光，就会先听到声音。

sentences.en: These explosions or banging sounds coming from somewhere deep inside the towers.
sentences.zh: 那是从楼内深处传来的爆炸声或撞击声。

sentences.en: I was talking about it with my friend Jones.
sentences.zh: 我当时正和我的朋友琼斯谈论这件事。

sentences.en: She was helping me translate from Cantonese that day.
sentences.zh: 那天她帮我做粤语翻译。

sentences.en: They suspect that it is a bathroom or kitchen.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑那是浴室或厨房。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Or maybe guests.
sentences.zh: 或者可能是客人。

sentences.en: And then the friend is quite serious.
sentences.zh: 然后那位朋友变得相当严肃。

sentences.en: Getting serious right now.
sentences.zh: 现在开始严肃起来了。

sentences.en: Julie was standing in a park just across the way from the burning complex.
sentences.zh: 朱莉当时正站在燃烧建筑群对面的一座公园里。

sentences.en: And all around her were people from the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 她周围全是附近的居民。

sentences.en: There was this 73-year-old guy called Ma Ming, a local,
sentences.zh: 有一位叫马明的73岁老伯，他是本地人，

sentences.en: who'd been at the park when the fire broke out the day before.
sentences.zh: 前一天火灾发生时他就在公园里。

sentences.en: He'd seen it start.
sentences.zh: 他目睹了起火过程。

sentences.en: He told me the flames just raced up those 32 floors.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，火焰瞬间就窜上了那32层楼。

sentences.en: And within 20 minutes, the firefighters had completely lost control.
sentences.zh: 不到20分钟，消防员就完全失去了控制。

sentences.en: And I asked him, because this was already the narrative that was forming in the news.
sentences.zh: 我问了他一个问题，因为当时新闻里已经开始形成这种说法了。

sentences.en: I'd read it on my phone on the way to the airport that morning.
sentences.zh: 那天早上在去机场的路上，我在手机上读到过。

sentences.en: I asked him, was it the bamboo?
sentences.zh: 我问他，是因为竹子吗？

sentences.en: The eight towers at Taipo had been undergoing renovation.
sentences.zh: 大埔的那八栋楼当时正在进行翻新。

sentences.en: And all seven that were on fire were wrapped from top to bottom in bamboo scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 而着火的七栋楼从上到下都包着竹脚手架。

sentences.en: In the immediate wake of the inferno, bamboo was the most obvious culprit.
sentences.zh: 在这场大火之后，竹子成了最明显的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: Breaking news from Hong Kong, where a massive fire has engulfed a housing complex.
sentences.zh: 香港突发新闻：一座住宅楼发生大火。

sentences.en: Bamboo scaffolding fixed on the outside of the towers is fueling the blaze.
sentences.zh: 固定在楼体外侧的竹脚手架正在助长火势。

sentences.en: The fire spread quickly due to bamboo scaffolding and highly flammable...
sentences.zh: 由于竹脚手架和高度易燃的……火势迅速蔓延。

sentences.en: The housing complex was covered in scaffolding made from bamboo, which appears to have helped the fire spread.
sentences.zh: 该住宅楼覆盖着竹制脚手架，这似乎助长了火势蔓延。

sentences.en: Combustible scaffolding should be prohibited.
sentences.zh: 应该禁止使用可燃脚手架。

sentences.en: I mean, we shouldn't use bamboo.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们不应该使用竹子。

sentences.en: This is an unnecessary risk for a catastrophic fire.
sentences.zh: 这是引发灾难性火灾的不必要风险。

sentences.en: But Ma was adamant in his answer.
sentences.zh: 但马老伯的回答非常坚定。

sentences.en: He said, no, it wasn't because of the bamboo that the fire spread so quickly.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，火势蔓延得这么快并不是因为竹子。

sentences.en: He insisted it was because of the plastic netting that had been draped around the bamboo.
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为是包裹在竹子外面的塑料网造成的。

sentences.en: That's what caught.
sentences.zh: 那是引燃物。

sentences.en: For someone who isn't from Hong Kong, our discussion at that moment might have appeared strange.
sentences.zh: 对于非香港本地人来说，我们当时的讨论可能显得很奇怪。

sentences.en: Maybe even insensitive.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能有些不近人情。

sentences.en: The buildings were still burning behind us.
sentences.zh: 我们身后的建筑还在燃烧。

sentences.en: Nearly 300 people were still unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 近300人仍下落不明。

sentences.en: And here we were distinguishing between construction materials.
sentences.zh: 而我们却在这里纠结建筑材料的区别。

sentences.en: Only that distinction, bamboo versus netting, would turn out to matter enormously.
sentences.zh: 但正是这种区别——竹子与塑料网——后来证明至关重要。

sentences.en: Because bamboo scaffolding is a tradition that has long helped set this city apart from the Chinese mainland.
sentences.zh: 因为竹脚手架是一项传统，长期以来让这座城市与中国内地截然不同。

sentences.en: But now the fire at Wong Fook Court might just spell the end of bamboo scaffolding in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 但现在，宏福苑的这场火灾可能预示着香港竹脚手架时代的终结。

sentences.en: If you've ever seen any images of Hong Kong, you've seen its bamboo.
sentences.zh: 如果你见过香港的照片，你就见过它的竹子。

sentences.en: It's just as iconic as Hong Kong's ferries, dim sum restaurants, skyscrapers, and neon signs.
sentences.zh: 它和香港的渡轮、点心酒楼、摩天大楼以及霓虹灯招牌一样具有标志性。

sentences.en: The omnipresent use of bamboo scaffolding for construction or renovation jobs.
sentences.zh: 这就是建筑或翻新工程中无处不在的竹脚手架。

sentences.en: In Hong Kong, entire skyscrapers are often fully encased in bamboo scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 在香港，整座摩天大楼往往被竹脚手架完全包裹。

sentences.en: On any given day, countless stalks of bamboo cover dozens of glass office buildings from top to bottom,
sentences.zh: 在任何一天，无数根竹竿从上到下覆盖着几十栋玻璃办公楼，

sentences.en: enveloping the city's skyline like a veil.
sentences.zh: 像面纱一样笼罩着城市的天际线。

sentences.en: It's really hard to overstate how much bamboo is part of Hong Kong's image and identity.
sentences.zh: 很难夸大竹子在香港形象和身份认同中的重要性。

sentences.en: In tourist shops, I even found these little plastic miniatures of Hong Kong buildings,
sentences.zh: 在旅游纪念品店里，我甚至发现了这些香港建筑的小塑料模型，

sentences.en: and they all included bamboo scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 它们全都包含了竹脚手架。

sentences.en: And for those who haven't had the chance to go to Hong Kong,
sentences.zh: 对于那些没机会去香港的人来说，

sentences.en: there's always this vital action scene in Rush Hour 2 with Jackie Chan and Chris Tucker.
sentences.zh: 成龙和克里斯·塔克主演的《尖峰时刻2》里总有那场至关重要的动作戏。

sentences.en: The scene hinges on a stunt in which Chan and Tucker maneuver across the bamboo scaffolding on the side of a building.
sentences.zh: 那场戏的关键在于一个特技，成龙和塔克在建筑侧面的竹脚手架上穿梭。

sentences.en: And they end up hanging from this one really tall piece of bamboo, which just bends and bends and bends.
sentences.zh: 最后他们挂在一根非常高的竹竿上，那根竹竿不停地弯曲、弯曲、再弯曲。

sentences.en: Don't worry!
sentences.zh: 别担心！

sentences.en: Chinese bamboo is very strong, I'm sure!
sentences.zh: 中国竹子很结实，我敢肯定！

sentences.en: Until finally, it breaks.
sentences.zh: 直到最后，它断了。

sentences.en: Because, you know, it's a comedy.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，这是一部喜剧。

sentences.en: You won't see anywhere near this much bamboo in the rest of China.
sentences.zh: 在中国其他地方，你根本看不到这么多竹子。

sentences.en: Today, on China's mainland, including where I live in Beijing,
sentences.zh: 如今，在中国内地，包括我居住的北京，

sentences.en: scaffolding is made out of metal, not bamboo.
sentences.zh: 脚手架是用金属做的，而不是竹子。

sentences.en: Other places in China might have their own vernacular building styles,
sentences.zh: 中国其他地方可能有自己本土的建筑风格，

sentences.en: but only in Hong Kong is the site of construction and maintenance itself part of the vernacular identity.
sentences.zh: 但只有在香港，建筑和维护的现场本身就是本土身份的一部分。

sentences.en: Perhaps no city on Earth more proudly displays its own upkeep.
sentences.zh: 也许地球上没有哪个城市比香港更自豪地展示其自身的维护过程。

sentences.en: Therefore, I say the bamboo scaffold is just like grow together with Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 因此，我说竹脚手架就像是与香港共同成长起来的。

sentences.en: This is Lo, an engineer with over 30 years of experience in Hong Kong's construction industry.
sentences.zh: 这位是罗先生，一位在香港建筑行业拥有30多年经验的工程师。

sentences.en: He asked me not to use his full name.
sentences.zh: 他要求我不要使用他的全名。

sentences.en: And Lo thinks the tradition of bamboo scaffolding hasn't survived here simply by accident.
sentences.zh: 罗先生认为，竹脚手架的传统能在这里保留下来绝非偶然。

sentences.en: Hong Kong, he says, was, by necessity, built with bamboo.
sentences.zh: 他说，香港是出于必要才用竹子建造起来的。

sentences.en: Hong Kong is a place where we don't have much flat land.
sentences.zh: 香港是一个平地不多的地方。

sentences.en: There's quite a lot of mountains, hills, and you can see Hong Kong Island.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多山峦、丘陵，你可以看看香港岛。

sentences.en: Most of the ground is sloping.
sentences.zh: 大部分地面都是倾斜的。

sentences.en: With a premium on usable land, Hong Kong is extraordinarily dense.
sentences.zh: 由于可用土地非常珍贵，香港极其拥挤。

sentences.en: Its streets are narrow, its alleys narrower.
sentences.zh: 街道狭窄，小巷更窄。

sentences.en: Construction and repair work in these spaces is notoriously tricky, requiring constant adaptation.
sentences.zh: 在这些空间里进行施工和维修非常棘手，需要不断调整。

sentences.en: Therefore, we try to use some, what can I describe, some very flexible and easy-to-mobilize solution for the problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们尝试使用一些——怎么形容呢——一些非常灵活且易于调动的解决方案来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: This is all the benefit of bamboo scaffold.
sentences.zh: 这就是竹脚手架的所有好处。

sentences.en: Bamboo is far lighter than steel.
sentences.zh: 竹子比钢材轻得多。

sentences.en: It's even lighter than wood.
sentences.zh: 它甚至比木头还轻。

sentences.en: It's actually a grass, so it can be easily carried and assembled by hand.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是一种草，所以可以很容易地由人工搬运和组装。

sentences.en: And there's no standard size.
sentences.zh: 而且没有标准尺寸。

sentences.en: You can quickly cut it down to suit whatever space it needs to fit.
sentences.zh: 你可以快速切割它，以适应任何需要安装的空间。

sentences.en: The result is that this ancient construction material is still useful, maybe even perfect, for modern, crowded Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，这种古老的建筑材料对于现代、拥挤的香港来说依然有用，甚至可以说是完美的。

sentences.en: There's a line from a bamboo scaffolding master that sums it up perfectly.
sentences.zh: 一位竹脚手架大师的一句话完美地总结了这一点。

sentences.en: Wherever a person fits, a bamboo scaffold fits.
sentences.zh: 人能到的地方，竹脚手架就能到。

sentences.en: And for something as straight as bamboo, you'd be surprised how many shapes can be made out of it.
sentences.zh: 对于像竹子这样笔直的东西，你可能会惊讶于它能做出这么多形状。

sentences.en: Walk around Hong Kong, and you'll see lopsided bamboo pyramids surrounding movie marquees and long bamboo tendrils snaking around windows.
sentences.zh: 走在香港街头，你会看到电影院招牌周围环绕着歪斜的竹金字塔，还有长长的竹藤缠绕在窗户周围。

sentences.en: And then there's this.
sentences.zh: 还有这个。

sentences.en: Bamboo scaffolding doesn't need to be anchored to the ground or descend from the roof of a structure with a crane.
sentences.zh: 竹脚手架不需要固定在地面上，也不需要用起重机从屋顶垂下。

sentences.en: Instead, the 65th floor of an office building is often the starting place for a typical bamboo platform.
sentences.zh: 相反，办公楼的65层往往是典型竹平台的起点。

sentences.en: Most of the time, it just shoots straight out of the window with nothing but air underneath it.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，它只是直接从窗户伸出来，下面空无一物。

sentences.en: From there, two scaffolders working alone can quickly build the bamboo out in any shape and direction that's required for the job,
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，两名脚手架工人可以迅速搭建出工作所需的任何形状和方向的竹架，

sentences.en: all without ever for a second touching the ground or blocking traffic.
sentences.zh: 全程无需触碰地面，也不会阻碍交通。

sentences.en: Heavy metal scaffolding, by contrast, usually needs to be built from the ground up.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，沉重的金属脚手架通常需要从地面向上搭建。

sentences.en: It comes in fixed tube lengths and requires clamps, platforms, and standardized components.
sentences.zh: 它有固定的管长，需要夹具、平台和标准化组件。

sentences.en: On a flat surface in an open space, it's fast and it's cheap.
sentences.zh: 在开阔空间的平地上，它既快又便宜。

sentences.en: But in a narrow alley, on a curved facade, on the side of a 64-story tower on a Hong Kong hillside,
sentences.zh: 但在狭窄的小巷、弯曲的立面上，或者香港山坡上一栋64层高楼的侧面，

sentences.en: steel becomes slow and expensive.
sentences.zh: 钢材就变得缓慢且昂贵了。

sentences.en: And bamboo scaffolding isn't just practical for patching up a building or making repairs.
sentences.zh: 而且竹脚手架不仅在修补建筑或进行维修时实用。

sentences.en: It's often the way skyscrapers are constructed in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 它通常也是香港建造摩天大楼的方式。

sentences.en: Hong Kong is famous for its daring and surreal architecture.
sentences.zh: 香港以其大胆而超现实的建筑而闻名。

sentences.en: And Lo believes that's because bamboo has made it easier for construction firms here to pursue ambitious designs more often.
sentences.zh: 罗先生认为，这是因为竹子让这里的建筑公司更容易频繁地追求雄心勃勃的设计。

sentences.en: He says, bamboo scaffolding is so easy to manipulate that it can be molded alongside any shape an architect requires.
sentences.zh: 他说，竹脚手架非常容易操作，可以根据建筑师要求的任何形状进行塑形。

sentences.en: Just like a tailor, because every time the angle of the scaffold perfectly matches the building shape.
sentences.zh: 就像裁缝一样，因为每一次脚手架的角度都能完美契合建筑的形状。

sentences.en: And if no choice, we have to use metal scaffolding, then maybe we need to use one or two months or more time for preparations.
sentences.zh: 如果没得选，我们必须使用金属脚手架，那么可能需要一两个月甚至更多的时间来准备。

sentences.en: Because everything is heavy by three or four times or more.
sentences.zh: 因为所有东西的重量都是原来的三四倍甚至更多。

sentences.en: Bamboo scaffolders usually require far less prep.
sentences.zh: 竹脚手架工人通常需要的准备工作要少得多。

sentences.en: Instead, most of the time, they just show up, eyeball the situation, and get to work.
sentences.zh: 相反，大多数时候，他们只是到场，目测一下情况，然后就开始工作。

sentences.en: Hey, good morning.
sentences.zh: 嘿，早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Almost in place.
sentences.zh: 快弄好了。

sentences.en: On a recent hot, humid day in Hong Kong, I watched one such scene play out from a tiny alley in the Prince Edward neighborhood,
sentences.zh: 在香港一个炎热潮湿的日子里，我在太子区的一条小巷里目睹了这样一幕，

sentences.en: next to two dim sum restaurants, The Jade and The Pearl.
sentences.zh: 旁边是两家点心酒楼：翡翠和珍珠。

sentences.en: The alley couldn't have been more than three meters wide, flanked on both sides by tall residential buildings.
sentences.zh: 那条小巷宽度不超过三米，两侧是高耸的住宅楼。

sentences.en: Two bamboo scaffolders, Timmy So and his father, So-Ti-Fai, were gathering materials from their truck.
sentences.zh: 两名竹脚手架工人，蒂米·苏和他的父亲苏志辉，正在从卡车上搬运材料。

sentences.en: Timmy briefed me on the job.
sentences.zh: 蒂米向我介绍了这项工作。

sentences.en: So that one will be the building.
sentences.zh: 那栋就是目标建筑。

sentences.en: Now we're working at the orange color one, but we can walk around to see all the pipes where they are.
sentences.zh: 现在我们在橙色的那栋楼工作，但我们可以走过去看看所有管道的位置。

sentences.en: And we're working at the 14th floor.
sentences.zh: 我们正在14楼工作。

sentences.en: The assignment that day was to build a bamboo balcony that could reach an air conditioning unit on the side of one of the buildings.
sentences.zh: 那天的工作任务是搭建一个竹阳台，以便触及建筑侧面的空调机组。

sentences.en: This is probably the single most common job scaffolders are asked to do here.
sentences.zh: 这可能是这里脚手架工人最常接到的工作。

sentences.en: Modern Hong Kong is nothing without its air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 现代香港离不开空调。

sentences.en: But Hong Kong's AC units are not the dinky one-off window units that you see in a lot of American apartments.
sentences.zh: 但香港的空调机组不是你在许多美国公寓里看到的那种简陋的窗式机。

sentences.en: They're usually located away from windows in hard-to-reach places,
sentences.zh: 它们通常位于远离窗户、难以触及的地方，

sentences.en: crammed alongside a complicated maze of pipes and fixtures for plumbing, electricity, internet, everything.
sentences.zh: 挤在复杂的管道、水管、电力、互联网等设施的迷宫中。

sentences.en: And this building was no different.
sentences.zh: 这栋楼也不例外。

sentences.en: But Timmy assured me they'd make quick work of it.
sentences.zh: 但蒂米向我保证，他们很快就能搞定。

sentences.en: You already came here before or is that what's happening now?
sentences.zh: 你之前来过这里，还是现在才开始？

sentences.en: No, it's happening now.
sentences.zh: 不，现在才开始。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've been here.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次来这里。

sentences.en: All their equipment seemed custom-made for Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 他们所有的设备看起来都是为香港量身定制的。

sentences.en: They had this tiny cart designed to slot exactly inside a standard Hong Kong elevator with just enough space on the side for two scaffolders.
sentences.zh: 他们设计了一种小推车，刚好能塞进香港的标准电梯里，旁边还留有足够的空间给两名搭架工人站立。

sentences.en: And on top of it, all their gear alongside bundles of bamboo.
sentences.zh: 推车上面放着他们所有的装备，还有一捆捆的竹竿。

sentences.en: Ooh, oh, it fits perfectly.
sentences.zh: 噢，哦，刚好合适。

sentences.en: Yes, everything is designed by ourselves.
sentences.zh: 是的，所有东西都是我们自己设计的。

sentences.en: So it fits most of the environment in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 所以它能适应香港的大部分环境。

sentences.en: You just, like, asked someone to make it precisely according to your own dimensions.
sentences.zh: 你就像是找人完全按照你们自己的尺寸定做的。

sentences.en: Actually, my father made it by himself.
sentences.zh: 其实是我父亲亲手做的。

sentences.en: So it's all unique design.
sentences.zh: 所以这都是独一无二的设计。

sentences.en: The elevator only went to the 13th floor.
sentences.zh: 电梯只到13楼。

sentences.en: They carried their supplies to the next floor themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们自己把物资搬到了下一层。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: They picked up the bamboo poles and walked up the stairs as if they weighed nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们拿起竹竿，走上楼梯，就像手里没拿东西一样轻松。

sentences.en: Which, compared to steel, they basically do.
sentences.zh: 和钢材比起来，它们确实轻得几乎没重量。

sentences.en: In which surely counts as one of the great disappointments of my life,
sentences.zh: 这无疑是我人生中最大的遗憾之一，

sentences.en: safety regulations prohibited me from going out onto the scaffolding with them.
sentences.zh: 因为安全规定禁止我跟他们一起上脚手架。

sentences.en: So I went back down, to gawk at them from the alley.
sentences.zh: 所以我回到下面，在巷子里呆呆地看着他们。

sentences.en: We stayed in touch by walkie-talkie.
sentences.zh: 我们通过对讲机保持联系。

sentences.en: Let me see if I can...
sentences.zh: 让我看看能不能……

sentences.en: Uh, maybe you need...
sentences.zh: 呃，也许你需要……

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, there you are.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，你在那儿。

sentences.en: I watched as Timmy, strapped into a harness, stepped out of a tiny window into the air
sentences.zh: 我看着蒂米系上安全带，从一个小窗户跨到半空中，

sentences.en: and balanced himself on a small length of pipe, about 45 meters above me.
sentences.zh: 在离我约45米高的地方，平衡在一根短管子上。

sentences.en: He drilled some metal brackets into the wall,
sentences.zh: 他把一些金属支架钻进墙里，

sentences.en: and then his father started handing him bamboo poles through the window, one by one.
sentences.zh: 然后他父亲开始从窗户把竹竿一根接一根地递给他。

sentences.en: He laid them across the brackets, tied them up, and built a little platform for himself to stand on.
sentences.zh: 他把竹竿横放在支架上，绑好，搭起了一个供自己站立的小平台。

sentences.en: The poles were light enough that he could just grab and hold them with one hand.
sentences.zh: 竹竿很轻，他单手就能抓握住。

sentences.en: Not exactly something you could do with steel.
sentences.zh: 这可不是用钢材能做到的。

sentences.en: So every time when I receive the material from the window, I have to treat the material.
sentences.zh: 所以每次我从窗户接过材料时，我都得先处理一下。

sentences.en: Then my partner can fill it, and he'll release the material from his hand.
sentences.zh: 然后我的搭档可以接手，他会松开手里的材料。

sentences.en: If he cannot fill it, he shouldn't release the material.
sentences.zh: 如果他没接稳，他就不能松手。

sentences.en: So we, uh, that's how...
sentences.zh: 所以我们，呃，就是这样……

sentences.en: Within a few minutes, Timmy was already well on his way to making what some in the industry call a birdcage,
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，蒂米就已经快搭好业内所说的“鸟笼”了，

sentences.en: a sort of safe enclosure for a repairman to work in.
sentences.zh: 这是一种供维修工人在里面作业的安全围栏。

sentences.en: Later, Timmy would tell me this was a tougher job than he thought.
sentences.zh: 后来，蒂米告诉我，这份工作比他想象的要难。

sentences.en: Lots of unexpected angles and distances.
sentences.zh: 有很多意想不到的角度和距离。

sentences.en: But from where I was standing, you wouldn't know it.
sentences.zh: 但从我站的地方看，你根本看不出来。

sentences.en: His father just kept handing him the bamboo poles at a steady rate.
sentences.zh: 他父亲只是保持着稳定的节奏不断递给他竹竿。

sentences.en: There's number six, and his father's already extending the seventh one while he's lashing the six into place.
sentences.zh: 那是第六根，当他在固定第六根时，他父亲已经在递第七根了。

sentences.en: Probably takes no longer than ten seconds to connect them.
sentences.zh: 连接它们大概只需要不到十秒钟。

sentences.en: There's some passersby who are wondering what we're so fascinated by.
sentences.zh: 有些路人很纳闷我们到底在看什么，看得这么入迷。

sentences.en: As I watched Timmy and his father build out the birdcage, the alley continued to go about his business.
sentences.zh: 当我看着蒂米和他父亲搭建鸟笼时，巷子里的人们依然在忙着自己的事。

sentences.en: Some cleaners came and went.
sentences.zh: 一些清洁工来来往往。

sentences.en: An employee from one of the dim sum restaurants took out some trash.
sentences.zh: 一家点心店的员工出来倒垃圾。

sentences.en: Another was moving around styrofoam boxes.
sentences.zh: 另一个人在搬运泡沫塑料箱。

sentences.en: And maybe that was the best part.
sentences.zh: 也许这才是最棒的部分。

sentences.en: The way the bamboo let everyone else's lives just go on.
sentences.zh: 竹架让其他人的生活得以照常进行。

sentences.en: Steel scaffolding for this job would have likely had to start from the ground floor, blocking half of this narrow alley.
sentences.zh: 如果这项工作用钢管脚手架，可能得从一楼搭起，挡住这条狭窄巷子的一半。

sentences.en: But this scaffold never got anywhere near the ground.
sentences.zh: 但这种竹架根本没碰到地面。

sentences.en: It stayed well out of the way of the hustle and bustle below.
sentences.zh: 它完全避开了下面熙熙攘攘的人群。

sentences.en: Ninety minutes later, the cage was finished.
sentences.zh: 九十分钟后，笼子搭好了。

sentences.en: Just another piece of bamboo scaffolding floating above one of the city's busiest neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 这只是漂浮在这个城市最繁忙街区上空的又一个竹脚手架。

sentences.en: Scenes like this are so commonplace that residents barely notice.
sentences.zh: 这样的场景太常见了，居民们几乎都注意不到。

sentences.en: But look up from nearly any street corner, and more likely than not, you can see bamboo scaffolders making the nearly impossible look easy.
sentences.zh: 但只要在几乎任何街角抬头看，你多半都能看到竹架工人们让看似不可能的任务变得轻而易举。

sentences.en: It's why bamboo still accounts for roughly 80% of all scaffolding in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么竹架目前仍占香港所有脚手架的80%左右。

sentences.en: But just because bamboo is easy to work with doesn't mean it's easy to learn.
sentences.zh: 但竹架虽然好用，并不代表容易学。

sentences.en: That's bamboo's one honest disadvantage compared to metal.
sentences.zh: 这是竹架相比金属脚手架唯一的一个明显劣势。

sentences.en: A bamboo master requires years of apprenticeship.
sentences.zh: 一位竹架大师需要多年的学徒生涯。

sentences.en: The craft has been passed down father to son, job by job.
sentences.zh: 这门手艺是父传子，通过一个个工程传承下来的。

sentences.en: I think it's the easiest way to explain is like a teacher.
sentences.zh: 我觉得最简单的解释方式就是像老师一样。

sentences.en: But in old days, when they learn from teacher, they live together.
sentences.zh: 但在过去，当他们跟老师学习时，他们住在一起。

sentences.en: They even help to cook.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至帮忙做饭。

sentences.en: They help to wash.
sentences.zh: 他们帮忙洗衣服。

sentences.en: So everything.
sentences.zh: 所以什么都做。

sentences.en: Timmy told me he's a third-generation scaffolder.
sentences.zh: 蒂米告诉我他是第三代搭架工人。

sentences.en: His family's company builds bamboo scaffolding all around town.
sentences.zh: 他家族的公司在全城搭建竹脚手架。

sentences.en: He's also the assistant head of a builder's association.
sentences.zh: 他还是建筑工会的一名副会长。

sentences.en: He said the work still challenges him, 12 years into the job, working together with his dad.
sentences.zh: 他说，入行12年，和父亲一起工作，这份工作依然充满挑战。

sentences.en: And at work, I'll call him Sifu.
sentences.zh: 在工作时，我会叫他“师傅”。

sentences.en: Master.
sentences.zh: 大师。

sentences.en: Master, yes.
sentences.zh: 大师，是的。

sentences.en: Are you a master already?
sentences.zh: 你已经是大师了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm also a master.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也是大师。

sentences.en: But on the Chinese mainland, where bamboo scaffolding was never as popular, this knowledge has almost entirely disappeared.
sentences.zh: 但在中国内地，竹脚手架从未如此普及，这种知识几乎已经完全消失了。

sentences.en: It was mostly replaced by metal decades ago.
sentences.zh: 几十年前，它就基本被金属脚手架取代了。

sentences.en: And in 2022, it was banned nationwide for all housing and municipal engineering.
sentences.zh: 而在2022年，它在全国范围内被禁止用于所有住房和市政工程。

sentences.en: Hong Kong is one of the last places on Earth where bamboo scaffolding survives as a living practice.
sentences.zh: 香港是地球上最后几个竹脚手架作为一种活态实践保留下来的地方之一。

sentences.en: Not as a heritage performance, but as the actual way buildings get built.
sentences.zh: 它不是一种遗产表演，而是建筑施工的实际方式。

sentences.en: But then came the fire.
sentences.zh: 但后来发生了那场火灾。

sentences.en: And the world watched as the towers in Taipo burned, covered in bamboo.
sentences.zh: 全世界都看着大埔的楼宇在燃烧，上面覆盖着竹架。

sentences.en: The search continues for survivors, and those are horrifying pictures.
sentences.zh: 搜救工作仍在继续，那些画面太可怕了。

sentences.en: And police say there are still people trapped inside the building.
sentences.zh: 警方称仍有人被困在楼内。

sentences.en: There are glimmers of torch lights on some floors.
sentences.zh: 在某些楼层可以看到手电筒的微光。

sentences.en: And the bamboo scaffolding on one of the 31-story tower blocks looks to have caught fire and is causing the flames to spread.
sentences.zh: 其中一栋31层高楼上的竹脚手架似乎着火了，导致火势蔓延。

sentences.en: And being a Hong Konger, it's one of the most horrific things that I have ever, words can't even describe it.
sentences.zh: 作为一个香港人，这是我见过最恐怖的事情之一，言语甚至无法描述。

sentences.en: When we come back, the possible end of bamboo scaffolding and what it means for Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 稍后回来，我们将探讨竹脚手架的可能终结，以及这对香港意味着什么。

sentences.en: We're back with reporter Julie Blusset.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来，我是记者朱莉·布鲁塞特。

sentences.en: The same day I flew in from Beijing to cover the fire at Wankfuk Court,
sentences.zh: 就在我从北京飞来报道华福邨火灾的当天，

sentences.en: Timmy So was called in for an emergency meeting at Hong Kong's Development Bureau.
sentences.zh: 蒂米·苏被叫去参加香港发展局的紧急会议。

sentences.en: And it had only been one day since the start of the fire.
sentences.zh: 那时距离火灾开始才过了一天。

sentences.en: And I was quite shocked that it comes so fast because the fire is not under control yet.
sentences.zh: 我非常震惊，因为行动太快了，火势甚至还没得到控制。

sentences.en: It's just still at the second day of the fire.
sentences.zh: 那才只是火灾的第二天。

sentences.en: And it's a little bit shocked.
sentences.zh: 这让人感到有点震惊。

sentences.en: A few months before, Hong Kong's government, under pressure from Beijing,
sentences.zh: 几个月前，香港政府在来自北京的压力下，

sentences.en: had already begun making local construction companies increase their use of metal scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 已经开始要求当地建筑公司增加金属脚手架的使用。

sentences.en: The government had cited safety concerns, although some suspected it was a way for Beijing
sentences.zh: 政府给出的理由是安全考虑，尽管有人怀疑这是一种方式，让北京

sentences.en: to bring in more mainland construction workers who are trained on metal.
sentences.zh: 引入更多受过金属脚手架培训的内地建筑工人。

sentences.en: So going into the meeting, Timmy was bracing himself.
sentences.zh: 所以去开会时，蒂米已经做好了心理准备。

sentences.en: And once I arrived at the meeting place, there is an agenda on the table.
sentences.zh: 当我到达会场时，桌上有一份议程。

sentences.en: And the agenda title is Roadmap on Adoption of Scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 议程标题是《脚手架采用路线图》。

sentences.en: It was a timetable drafted by the Development Bureau for the complete phase-out of bamboo scaffolding
sentences.zh: 这是发展局起草的一份时间表，旨在全面淘汰竹脚手架，

sentences.en: at all construction sites in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 用于香港所有的建筑工地。

sentences.en: The official rationale was straightforward.
sentences.zh: 官方理由很简单。

sentences.en: Metal scaffolding is more fire-resistant than bamboo.
sentences.zh: 金属脚手架比竹架更防火。

sentences.en: The Bureau asked the Hong Kong construction industry to agree to the accelerated phase-out of bamboo.
sentences.zh: 发展局要求香港建筑业同意加速淘汰竹架。

sentences.en: It was time, they said, to move on.
sentences.zh: 他们说，是时候向前看了。

sentences.en: Timmy still spoke up.
sentences.zh: 蒂米还是发了言。

sentences.en: He resisted the ban, but only briefly.
sentences.zh: 他抵制了这项禁令，但只是简短地表达了意见。

sentences.en: It was already clear that more than a hundred people had died in the fire.
sentences.zh: 当时已经很清楚，火灾中有一百多人死亡。

sentences.en: And so, he says, resistance felt both pointless and almost inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，抵制既显得毫无意义，也几乎是不合时宜的。

sentences.en: So, everyone, they forgot how bamboo scaffolding builds Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 所以，大家都忘了竹脚手架是如何构建香港的了。

sentences.en: And at that time, I was very disappointed, very hopeless.
sentences.zh: 当时我感到非常失望，非常绝望。

sentences.en: Shortly after that, the phase-out was made public by the Hong Kong government.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，香港政府公布了淘汰计划。

sentences.en: Bamboo scaffolding would be replaced with metal.
sentences.zh: 竹脚手架将被金属脚手架取代。

sentences.en: Hong Kong's roughly 3,500 bamboo scaffolders would be incentivized to retrain, to work with steel.
sentences.zh: 香港约3500名竹架工人将获得激励去重新培训，改用钢材。

sentences.en: But almost immediately, something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 但几乎立刻，发生了一些意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: The public pushed back.
sentences.zh: 公众进行了反击。

sentences.en: People began posting videos online, trying and failing to set bamboo alight.
sentences.zh: 人们开始在网上发布视频，尝试点燃竹子，但都失败了。

sentences.en: Bamboo has a very high ignition point of at least 260 degrees Celsius, and it is also very difficult to burn.
sentences.zh: 竹子的燃点很高，至少在260摄氏度以上，而且非常难烧着。

sentences.en: No one was saying that the bamboo scaffolding hadn't caught fire along with everything else in Taipo.
sentences.zh: 没有人说大埔火灾时竹脚手架没有和其他东西一起着火。

sentences.en: It had.
sentences.zh: 它确实着火了。

sentences.en: The question was whether the scaffolding was what caused the fire to spread.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，火势蔓延是否是由脚手架引起的。

sentences.en: Bamboo's defender said, no, the bamboo only burned after the flames had already spread.
sentences.zh: 竹架的捍卫者说，不，竹子是在火势已经蔓延之后才烧起来的。

sentences.en: Not before.
sentences.zh: 而不是之前。

sentences.en: It wasn't the reason the fire got so bad.
sentences.zh: 它不是火灾变得如此严重的原因。

sentences.en: Instagram accounts ran posts claiming, bamboo is innocent.
sentences.zh: Instagram账号发布帖子声称，“竹子是无辜的”。

sentences.en: And at a makeshift memorial that sprung up near the site of the fire,
sentences.zh: 在火灾现场附近临时搭建的纪念处，

sentences.en: right next to notes expressing grief for the victims,
sentences.zh: 就在表达对遇难者哀悼的纸条旁边，

sentences.en: I saw messages saying, don't blame the bamboo.
sentences.zh: 我看到了写着“不要责怪竹子”的信息。

sentences.en: This is actually one of the things that got me so interested in this story in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这其实就是最初让我对这个故事产生兴趣的原因之一。

sentences.en: Like, why did Hong Kongers rush to defend bamboo so fiercely?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么香港人会如此激烈地捍卫竹架？

sentences.en: I put the question to Lo, the Hong Kong engineer.
sentences.zh: 我把这个问题抛给了香港工程师罗先生。

sentences.en: I told him about Ma Meng, the man who defended the bamboo,
sentences.zh: 我告诉他关于马孟的事，那个捍卫竹架的人，

sentences.en: even as the towers were still burning in front of us.
sentences.zh: 即使当时大楼还在我们面前燃烧。

sentences.en: People were so adamant about it.
sentences.zh: 人们对此非常坚持。

sentences.en: Like, no, it's not the bamboo.
sentences.zh: 就像是，不，不是竹子的问题。

sentences.en: When the fire is even still happening.
sentences.zh: 当火灾甚至还在发生的时候。

sentences.en: The bamboo is still burning at the same time.
sentences.zh: 竹子当时也在同时燃烧。

sentences.en: Why do the Hong Kong people care so much?
sentences.zh: 为什么香港人这么在乎？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why people respond like that?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们会有那样的反应？

sentences.en: Oh, can I say, the people you met, they're smart.
sentences.zh: 哦，我可以这么说，你遇到的人，他们很聪明。

sentences.en: They're smart.
sentences.zh: 他们很聪明。

sentences.en: They're smart.
sentences.zh: 他们很聪明。

sentences.en: Yeah, because we lived with the bamboo for so many years, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我们和竹子一起生活了这么多年，对吧？

sentences.en: From our child age, we see everywhere there's bamboo.
sentences.zh: 从我们小时候起，我们看到到处都是竹子。

sentences.en: We love it.
sentences.zh: 我们热爱它。

sentences.en: The tradition of bamboo scaffolding, that still means something to Hong Kongers.
sentences.zh: 竹脚手架的传统，对香港人来说依然意义非凡。

sentences.en: But also, they weren't just defending a construction material for the sake of convention.
sentences.zh: 但同时，他们不仅仅是为了传统而捍卫一种建筑材料。

sentences.en: 168 people died in this fire and thousands lost their homes.
sentences.zh: 这场火灾中有168人丧生，数千人失去了家园。

sentences.en: People were sad and upset.
sentences.zh: 人们感到悲伤和难过。

sentences.en: And Lo stressed to me how eager he and others were to find out what really went wrong.
sentences.zh: Lo向我强调，他和许多人是多么渴望找出真正出错的原因。

sentences.en: But instead, it felt like the government was using bamboo as a scapegoat, a way to declare
sentences.zh: 但相反，感觉政府是在把竹子当作替罪羊，以此作为一种方式来宣布

sentences.en: the case closed, instead of looking for the real culprit.
sentences.zh: 案件已结，而不是去寻找真正的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: Therefore, we're angry about this.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And we realized that this is useless because the problem is still there.
sentences.zh: 而且我们意识到这毫无用处，因为问题依然存在。

sentences.en: And a similar thing may be happening again, right?

sentences.zh: 还有这座城市标志性的霓虹灯招牌，那些密集的、重叠的、照亮了香港街道几十年的中文字幕瀑布，

sentences.en: lit up Hong Kong streets for decades, Beijing had almost all of those taken down.
sentences.zh: 北京几乎把它们全部拆除了。

sentences.en: Also, they said, for safety concerns.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们说，这是出于安全考虑。

sentences.en: But just saying these things outright, at least in public, has become too risky for most people.
sentences.zh: 但至少在公开场合直接说出这些话，对大多数人来说已经变得太冒险了。

sentences.zh: 一名70多岁的政治评论员因在网上批评政府的应对措施而被捕。

sentences.en: The result is that most people in Hong Kong err on the side of keeping their thoughts private, or at least anonymous.

sentences.zh: 火灾发生五天后，我遇到了这群正在拍摄音乐录影带的年轻人。

sentences.en: A 26-year-old rapper named Chun Geet K, dressed head-to-toe in black, rapping directly into the camera.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫Chun Geet K的26岁说唱歌手，全身穿着黑色，对着摄像机直接说唱。

sentences.en: I don't speak Cantonese, so I couldn't make out much, until I caught the word bamboo.
sentences.zh: 我不懂粤语，所以我听不太懂，直到我听到了“竹子”这个词。

sentences.en: Turned out, Chun's song was about bamboo.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，Chun的歌是关于竹子的。

sentences.en: Bamboo is my name, stubborn by nature, it goes.
sentences.zh: 竹子是我的名字，天性固执，它唱道。

sentences.zh: 竹子是我的名字，比你想象的更坚强。

sentences.en: The week before, shortly after the fire broke out, Chun had rushed to Tai Po to help out.
sentences.zh: 前一周，火灾爆发后不久，Chun曾赶到大埔帮忙。

sentences.en: He delivered water and food to the firefighters.
sentences.zh: 他给消防员送去了水和食物。

sentences.en: And now, he said, he wanted to use his music to help the bamboo as well.
sentences.zh: 现在，他说，他也想用他的音乐来帮助竹子。

sentences.zh: 因为火灾，我们都意识到有些人责怪竹子。

sentences.zh: Chun正在香港边缘的西湾村录制音乐录影带。

sentences.en: The village was holding a festival that only happens every 10 years.
sentences.zh: 这个村庄正在举行一个每10年才举行一次的节日。

sentences.en: For the festival, they build a temporary bamboo theater.
sentences.zh: 为了这个节日，他们建造了一个临时的竹戏棚。

Cantonese opera.

sentences.zh: 当Julie访问时，它还在建设中。

sentences.en: It was extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这太不寻常了。

sentences.zh: 只是这个巨大的竹骨架完全向天空敞开。

sentences.zh: 你可以穿过它，穿过这些竹竿走廊，

sentences.zh: 大约30米高，像一个巨大的马戏团帐篷那么大。

sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，我只是躺在地上，抬头看着这个结构，

sentences.zh: 看着这个向上延伸的错综复杂的竹网。

sentences.zh: 我问其中一位节日组织者，

sentences.zh: 如果竹子被禁，这个节日还能举行吗？

sentences.zh: 他没有确定的答案。

sentences.zh: 但他确实说，我无法想象用金属建造这个。

sentences.zh: 竹艺大师Timmy So今年38岁。

sentences.zh: 他以为自己还有几十年的工作要做，还有一门手艺要传承。

sentences.en: Now he's not sure.
sentences.zh: 现在他不确定了。

sentences.zh: 当地培训中心已经取消了新竹脚手架工所需的课程。

sentences.zh: 政府也正在为所有3500名现有的竹工提供激励措施，

sentences.zh: 让他们转换执照，获得金属脚手架工作的执照。

sentences.zh: 目标是在两年内将所有主要建筑工地的竹子完全替换为金属。

sentences.zh: 所以我认为有点太晚了，但至少有人注意到了我们。

sentences.zh: 火灾已经过去半年多了，
